ValidationRule.description: Check if the fields "Last Trade Date FI", "Last Trade Date FX" and "Last Trade Date Cash Equity" are neither not null nor greater than today.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, OR ( AND(ISBLANK(Last_Trade_Date_Cash_Equity__c), ISBLANK(Last_Trade_Date_FI__c), ISBLANK(Last_Trade_Date_FX__c) ), Last_Trade_Date_Cash_Equity__c > TODAY(), Last_Trade_Date_FI__c > TODAY(), Last_Trade_Date_FX__c > TODAY(), PRIORVALUE(Last_Trade_Date_Cash_Equity__c) > Last_Trade_Date_Cash_Equity__c, PRIORVALUE(Last_Trade_Date_FI__c) > Last_Trade_Date_FI__c, PRIORVALUE(Last_Trade_Date_FX__c) > Last_Trade_Date_FX__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Last Trade Date fields cannot be null or greater than today or earlier than existing date
